title: Perfect simulation for interacting Hawkes processes with reset-induced variable length memory
summary: We study a class of interacting nonlinear Hawkes point processes on the integer lattice in which each component is reset after its own jumps. The intensity of a component depends on the post-reset activity of its nearest neighbours, which produces a variable-length memory structure. We develop a graphical construction based on a dominating Poisson environment and introduce the clan of ancestors of a space-time point.
